# Parameters

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_parameters_doc.py from nextflow_schema.json. Do not edit. -->

Parameters are passed to Nextflow as `--name value`. Reference paths are
written to `conf/references.config` by the installer, and primers are
maintained in `conf/primers.config`.

## Input/output options

Study manifests and the result directory.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--samples` | string |  | Production sample manifest (TSV). See docs/inputs.md. |
| `--input` | string |  | Alias for --samples. |
| `--controls` | string |  | Control relationship table (TSV). See docs/inputs.md. |
| `--paired_controls` | string |  | Alias for --controls. |
| `--outdir` (required) | string | `results` | Directory for published results. |

## Reference databases

Written to conf/references.config by ./install.sh; normally not set by hand.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--reference_root` | string |  | Reference installation root, mounted read-only into containers. Set automatically by `triarchy run` for container profiles. |
| `--host_index` | string |  | Bowtie2 host index base path used for host-read removal. |
| `--kraken2_db` | string |  | Kraken2 database directory (PlusPFP). |
| `--kraken2_memory_mapping` | boolean | `true` | Run Kraken2 with --memory-mapping instead of loading the database into RAM. |
| `--bracken_read_length` | integer | `150` | Read length of the Bracken k-mer distribution to use. |
| `--humann_db` | string |  | HUMAnN ChocoPhlAn nucleotide database directory. |
| `--humann_protein_db` | string |  | HUMAnN UniRef90 protein database directory. |
| `--metaphlan_db` | string |  | MetaPhlAn marker database directory. |
| `--metaphlan_index` | string |  | MetaPhlAn index name, e.g. mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202307. |
| `--s16_taxonomy` | string |  | DADA2-formatted SILVA training FASTA for 16S taxonomy. |
| `--its_taxonomy` | string |  | DADA2-formatted UNITE FASTA for ITS taxonomy. |
| `--taxonomy_crosswalk` | string |  | Optional curated taxonomy crosswalk TSV applied during harmonization. |

## Assay configuration

Maintained centrally in conf/primers.config; change only when the laboratory protocol changes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cutadapt_16s_forward` | string | `CCTACGGGNGGCWGCAG` | 16S forward primer (IUPAC). |
| `--cutadapt_16s_reverse` | string | `GACTACHVGGGTATCTAATCC` | 16S reverse primer (IUPAC). |
| `--cutadapt_its_forward` | string | `GTGAATCATCGAATCTTTGAA` | ITS forward primer (IUPAC). |
| `--cutadapt_its_reverse` | string | `TCCTCCGCTTATTGATATGC` | ITS reverse primer (IUPAC). |
| `--itsxpress_region` | string (`ITS1`, `ITS2`, `ALL`) | `ITS2` | ITS region extracted by ITSxpress. |
| `--fastp_extra` | string |  | Extra arguments appended to the fastp command for WMS QC. |

## Evidence model

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--assay_performance` | string |  | Assay detection-performance table. Defaults to conf/assay_performance.tsv. |
| `--evidence_policy` | string |  | Evidence classification thresholds. Defaults to conf/evidence_policy.json. |

## Resource options

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--humann_time` | string | `48h` | Wall-time limit for each HUMAnN task. |
